feature: Appearance and Effects menus wear the panel's dropdown
summary: Blending, Masked by, a shadow's or glow's Kind, a border's Follows and Position, and a saved effect style's Kind now look like Font and Fade In: the same filled box with a chevron, filling the row. Every dropdown in the panel also moved 4pt right, onto the column the sliders start on.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/appearance-and-effects-dropdowns-open-on-a-click-walk.json.

try.do: Before: type a label and pick it. Blending and Masked by had up and down arrows, under Font's chevron.
Now: type a label with the Text tool, press ⌘Return, and look at Appearance under Text.
Click Blending near its right end and rest the pointer on Multiply, then click it.
Click Masked by and pick Its shape, then set it back to Nothing.
Add a Glow and a Border from the plus on Effects, set Follows to Box and Position to Inside.
Switch the Mac to Light and look at the same rows.
Save the shadow as a style from its Style menu, open the style in the Library and change its Kind.

evaluate: Does the Appearance section now read as the same app as the Text section above it?
Is Font's left edge on the same line as Blending's and the Opacity slider's now that it moved 4pt right?
Does Blending still paint each mode on the canvas as you move down its list?
Does a two-choice Kind (Drop or Inner) feel right as a dropdown, or would you rather see both choices at once?
rough: Blending and Masked by open their list in a popover with an arrow, where Font's menu hangs flush under its face as the fields mock's Open state draws it (comp-fields.html, 05 Select). Kept on purpose because a menu cannot paint each blend mode on the canvas as you rest on it, which the task's goal asked to keep (the-appearance-and-effects-menus-wear-the-same-d).
Shadow Kind, Glow Kind and Follows have two choices, and the fields mock says two choices are a segmented control, not a dropdown: two-choice-effect-settings-are-a-segmented-contr.

Twelve more panel menus are still the system pop-up: the measure and crop tools, a lens, a Library text style and component properties. Converting them is the-tool-lens-text-style-and-component-menus-in; a test now stops the count from growing.
Opening Blending or Masked by again within about a second of picking from it sometimes does nothing in a walk, before this change as well as after. Not seen by a hand yet; noted in this task's log.
